quarterly_data.quarter: Apple press release: The new Mac mini and Mac Studio are available today (09-22-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Apple's new Mac mini and Mac Studio became available starting September 22, 2026, powered by new Apple silicon: Mac mini with the all-new M6 and with M5 Pro, and Mac Studio with M5 Max and the all-new M5 Ultra. M6: 12-core CPU, 12-core GPU with Neural Accelerators built into each core, the all-new Dual 16-core Neural Engine, 16GB of unified memory configurable up to 32GB, memory bandwidth up to 170GB/s; Apple says M6 brings up to 4x faster AI performance versus the previous-generation Mac mini with M4. M5 Pro: up-to-18-core CPU, up-to-20-core GPU, up to 64GB of unified memory with 307GB/s of bandwidth. M5 Max: 18-core CPU, up-to-40-core GPU, up to 128GB of unified memory. M5 Ultra: up-to-36-core CPU, up-to-80-core GPU, up to 512GB of unified memory with 1.2TB/s of memory bandwidth; Apple says Mac Studio brings up to 4.3x faster AI performance (Apple testing). Thunderbolt 5 with RDMA lets multiple Mac Studio systems be clustered for up to 3x faster distributed AI inference versus a single system. Mac Studio with 512GB of unified memory is coming in late October. Starting prices: Mac mini with M6 $899, with M5 Pro $1,699; Mac Studio with M5 Max $2,499, with M5 Ultra $5,499. The release does not name the foundry or process node.
quarterly_data.figure: M6 and M5 Ultra launched (available September 22); M5 Ultra up to 512GB unified memory at 1.2TB/s; 512GB Mac Studio coming in late October; Mac mini from $899, Mac Studio from $2,499
